title: Fetish Plug Talk Podcast
author: Fetish Plug Talk Podcast
description: At Fetish Plug Talk, our mission is to break down barriers and stigma surrounding fetishes & alternative sexualities. We strive to foster conversations that encourage shame-free acceptance, self-awareness and education. Through candid discussions and intriguing interviews, we aim to empower our listeners to embrace their desires & navigate their journeys with confidence and authenticity! Disclaimer: We're not licensed therapists or mental health professionals. If you're in crisis, please contact local emergency services.
